content.value: The air flow to a 4-stroke 4-cylinder oil engine is measured by means of a 8 cm diameter orifice with Ca = 0.65. During a test on the engine the following data were recorded:

Bore x stroke = 11.5 cm x 13 cm, engine speed = 1300 rpm, brake torque = 150 N.m, fuel consumption= 5.2 kg/hr, heating value of fuel= 43 MJ/kg, head across orifice = 6 cm of water, ambient temperature and pressure is 25 C and 1 bar respectively. Calculate - (i) thermal efficiency on b.p. basis, (ii) brake mean effective pressure, (iii) volumetric efficiency based on free air condition.
